top_signals.title: Shell and Exxon’s $8bn UK chemicals unit put up for sale
top_signals.summary: Infineum taps advisers at Bank of America to run a sale of the business as Shell focuses on core oil and gas operations
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: High-Yield 'A Tale of Two Markets': Pimco's Karoui
top_signals.summary: Lotfi Karoui, multi-asset credit strategist at Pimco, and Jeff Sherman, deputy CIO of DoubleLine Capital, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss hyperscaler debt, capex spending, and the high-yield market. (Source: Bloomberg)
